description: Capability group: fs-write. Maps to command_scope::CommandScope::FsWrite. NOTE: Tauri 2 capability permissions system only covers built-in plugins (fs/dialog/shell/etc). For EchoAgent's custom commands, window-level scope enforcement lives in Rust via crate::command_scope::enforce(window.label(), command_name). This file documents the grouping and provides a forward-compatible scaffold for when command-level capability lands in Tauri (tracked as P0-3 follow-up).
